correctness.rationale: A two-class first- and second-iterate calculation yields the exact survivor-count trichotomy for any n>=3 and noninteger threshold. All zero states are absorbing; singleton survivors are correctly treated as fixed biomass two, not as period-two cycles. Exact enumeration of 25,560 rational initial states and binomial group counts passed. The asymptotic mixture follows from the binomial CLT, and tie events cost at most two maximal binomial atoms, O(n^(-1/2)). Infinite claims do not rely on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The recently documented shift of the K=2 extinction threshold from small degree to complete mixing motivates exact finite-population survival probabilities. The classification yields a closed binomial census at every generic n and identifies the n^(-1/2) critical window and a discontinuous limiting occupation law, specifying finite-size rounding absent from the stated threshold alone. It has concrete ecological observables and a natural all-to-all interaction domain, not an arbitrary parameter enumeration.
